top_news.title: Philadelphia Phillies Takes 4-3 Win
top_news.summary: Philadelphia Phillies beat Atlanta Braves 4-3. Bryce Harper: 2 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, 5 AB Tyler Mahle: 7.0 IP, 6 K, 1 ER, 1 BB, 6 H Alec Bohm homers (1) on a fly ball to right field.

top_news.title: Chicago White Sox Takes 7-3 Win
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox beat Houston Astros 7-3. Chase Meidroth: 2 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI, 3 AB Bryan Abreu: 2.2 IP, 6 K, 1 ER, 1 BB, 1 H Chase Meidroth homers (1) on a fly ball to left field. Luisangel Acuña scores. Tristan Peters scores.

top_news.title: New York Yankees Takes 2-9 Win
top_news.summary: New York Yankees beat Boston Red Sox 2-9. Cody Bellinger: 2 H, 1 HR, 4 RBI, 5 AB Max Fried: 6.0 IP, 6 K, 1 ER, 1 BB, 3 H Austin Wells singles on a ground ball to center fielder Ceddanne Rafaela. Jazz Chisholm Jr. scores. Trent Grisham to 3rd.
